description:
26" Electric Beach Cruiser Bike for Men – Powerful & Stylish Ride

Introducing the Tracer Classic Stretch Chopper Hi-Ten Steel Electric Bike – the ultimate blend of style, power, and comfort. Featuring a sleek design and robust performance, it’s built to turn heads and deliver an unforgettable ride.
Equipped with a Tracer Classical Springer Disc Brake fork and a Springer Suspension shock, you'll experience a smooth and comfortable ride, even on bumpy roads.
The Alloy 25.4mmx200mm seatpost and Vacuum elastic PVC leather+high density PU foam with springs saddle offer a comfortable and customizable riding experience, while the Nylon Platform one-piece PP pedals provide durability and traction.
This electric bike features a toggle switch that allows you to easily switch between three levels of assist, providing you with a faster ride and a smooth cycling experience.
Equipped with a powerful 48V 800W light weight high speed brushless rear hub motor and a LG Lithium Li-ion 48V/17.5Ah battery, this electric bike can travel up to 30 miles on pure electric mode and reach a maximum speed of 25 miles per hour.
the Tracer Classic Stretch Chopper Hi-Ten Steel Electric Bike is a powerful, stylish, and comfortable electric bike that offers a smooth and efficient riding experience. With its impressive range, speed, and performance, this electric bike is perfect for anyone looking for an eco-friendly and efficient mode of transportation.

COLORS

RED, Blue, Green, Purple, Black

SADDLE

Vacuum elastic PVC leather+high density PU foam with springs

SHIFTERS
A faster ride, right at your fingertips. Toggle between three levels of assist with easy-to-use on-bar controls.

BOTTOM BRACKET
Adjustable 12 Magnet Cadence Sensor, BB Mount

REAR HUB MOTOR
Equipped with 48V 800W light weight high speed brushless

SENSOR
Speed and Torque Integrated intelligent Pedals Assisted System

LIGHTS
Front and Rear LED with brake function

TIRES

Innova FAT white wall 26x3.0

PACKAGE

203*25*86CM. 48KG

FENDERS

Painted steel 5" fenders

EXTRAS
This Lithium Battery 26 Inch Electric Stretch Chopper Bike is powered by 48V/17.5Ah Li-ion battery which can be charged in 4-6 hours. It is constructed with Hi-ten steel. Equipped with 800W light weight high speed brushless rear wheel hub motor (EU), it can achieve a maximum speed of 25mile/h with a travel range of 30-50mile. It has an intelligent Pedals Assisted System 3 riding modes and 5 levels of pedal assist, which makes it like a normal bike and provides a natural riding experience, right at your fingertips. Toggle between three levels of assist with easy-to-use on-bar controls. Will be a better choice for long time travel and exercise.
